mentions.name: Business Website Rebuild
mentions.description: A business website being rebuilt with Claude to be significantly better than the old site and migrate off WordPress after the previous web designer broke something and stopped responding.
mentions.problem: The web designer broke something on the WordPress site and stopped answering, prompting a full rebuild and migration off WordPress.
mentions.source_excerpt: Rebuilding my business’ website with Claude. It’s gonna be 10x better and migrate off Wordpress. My web designer broke something and stopped answering so giving it a shot and it’s going great so far.
mentions.author: bix6
